list: Official PS5 trophy list, 55 trophies (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden), as published on PlayStation Network and listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 18 November 2026
notes: All guides below are written in our own words for this guide. Each cites the guide or list it draws on; the official trophy names and descriptions are quoted as PlayStation publishes them. One trophy is potentially missable: Positive Mental Attitude. There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter. Cheats disable trophies and saving, so keep them off on a trophy run.

roadmap.text: Finish all five chapters and the story missions inside them. Do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 before that chapter ends — it is the one thing in the whole list that can be missed. Take optional missions as they appear and scan vehicles and study animals as you travel, because that progress counts later.
roadmap.title: Play the story, Chapters 1-5

roadmap.text: With Jason and Lucia both playable, finish the side-story finales for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, the eight Strangers & Freaks strands, Bret's hunt, and the partner trophies that need the two of them together.
roadmap.title: Partners and side strands

roadmap.text: Unlock the robbery tools through the story, then rob the jewelry stores, bank vaults, armored trucks and gang operations, launder marked bills through contacts, and buy the garages and register vehicles.
roadmap.title: Robberies and money

roadmap.text: Work through the counted goals: 250 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, drone races, races, fishing, arcade games, card sets, WAiNK spots, vehicles, challenges, and exploring every region of Leonida.
roadmap.time: the bulk of the remaining hours
roadmap.title: Collectibles and the long grind

roadmap.text: After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and finish the checklist (70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicles, 15 of 18 meditation spots and the rest). A Long Road pops when it hits 100%, and Vice Got a Price! follows at once.
roadmap.title: 100% completion, then the Platinum

trophies.guide: The Platinum pops by itself the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. It needs no multiplayer and no DLC, and on Xbox the same achievement exists but is worth 0 Gamerscore. Plan around the long pole instead: A Long Road (100% completion) is the last trophy for almost everyone, so treat the roadmap's phase 5 as the road to this one.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn every other trophy in this guide, in any order.
Finish the 100% completion checklist last — that is what unlocks A Long Road.
The Platinum unlocks automatically once the 54th trophy pops.

trophies.guide: This is the first story trophy and it unlocks on its own: finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. Nothing can be missed here — just play the mission through to its end and the trophy pops with the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start Chapter 1 and play the opening mission Gone Fishing.
Follow the on-screen objectives until the mission ends.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one missable thing in the game: Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude). Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter, because there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play through all of Chapter 1's story missions.
Before the chapter ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation (Chapter 1, morning, after Down to Earth).
The trophy pops when Chapter 1 completes.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Character switching between Jason and Lucia opens after the Breakfast Run mission in this chapter, which is what makes the partner trophies possible later. The trophy pops when the chapter closes, and it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play through all of Chapter 2's story missions, including Breakfast Run.
The trophy pops when Chapter 2 completes.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. This is the chapter where the robbery tools start arriving — the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs opens jewelry store robberies — so it is worth clearing the story missions here before spending much time on free-roam robberies. The trophy pops when the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play through all of Chapter 3's story missions.
Pick up the robbery tools the chapter hands out as you go.
The trophy pops when Chapter 3 completes.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. Near the end of this chapter an optional mission, That's Where The Money Is, unlocks the bank vault robberies — take it when it appears, since vaults feed both Maximum Withdrawal and the 100% checklist. The trophy pops when the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play through all of Chapter 4's story missions.
Take the optional mission That's Where The Money Is when it appears, to unlock bank vaults.
The trophy pops when Chapter 4 completes.

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission and this gold trophy pops. It is the last of the 12 story trophies and the only gold among them. Keep a manual save from just before the final mission: there is no mission replay, and a save from before the ending is the safest way to keep every option open for the free-roam cleanup that follows.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Make a manual save just before the final mission.
Play the final mission through to the credits.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. This is the mission that opens character switching between Jason and Lucia, so it matters beyond its own trophy: once it is done you can call your partner in for the partner trophies. It unlocks automatically as you play the story and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Play Chapter 2 until the Breakfast Run mission appears.
Complete the mission; character switching unlocks right after it.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Like every mission trophy, it pops automatically when the mission ends, so there is no special requirement — just play the story until this heist comes up and finish it.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Play the story until The Cartel Heist mission appears.
Complete the heist mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It pops automatically when the mission ends, as part of playing through the story — no extra objective and nothing that can be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Play the story until the Child's Play mission appears.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It pops automatically when the mission ends, as part of playing through the story — no extra objective and nothing that can be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Play the story until the Headliners mission appears.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. It pops automatically when the mission ends. The airport is also where Catch Me If You Can is earned later, so you will already know the layout when you come back for the free-roam trophies.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Play the story until the VCIA Takedown mission appears.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops automatically when the mission ends, as part of playing through the story — no extra objective and nothing that can be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Play the story until the Operation Savage Glory mission appears.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), which only appears after the story — but work done earlier still counts. PowerPyx rates this the hardest trophy and the whole set 4/10 at about 200 hours. The checklist is lenient: it is roughly 60% of true completion. Its counted parts include 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars, 15 of 18 meditation spots, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 illegal operations. Most of it fills in while you earn the other trophies; the last stretch is a deliberate cleanup after the credits.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story so the checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Work through its lines: stunts to 300, challenges to 70 of 80, vehicles to 200 of 277, animals to 100 of 255, meditation spots to 15 of 18, all 8 vaults and all 39 illegal operations.
The trophy pops the moment the checklist hits 100% — then the Platinum follows.

trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count toward the same total, and there are 397 stunts in the world — so you do not need the hard ones. Keep going past 250: the 100% checklist needs 300. Scan the map for stunt markers as you travel and grab them in passing instead of saving them all for the end.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Do stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps — any kind counts.
Track the total in the Progress menu; 250 pops the trophy, 300 is needed for 100%.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try one of each activity type in the game. The nine types are the side activities Leonida offers — racing, fishing, shooting range, drone races, arcade games, gym training, meditation, hunting and the other open-world activities — so the fastest route is to sample one of each as you meet them rather than grinding any single one. If the counter stalls, check which activity type you have never touched and try that one next.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Play one session of each activity type: race, fishing, shooting range, drone race, arcade game, gym, meditation, hunting and the remaining open-world activities.
The trophy pops once every type has been tried at least once.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across two shooting ranges. This is a skill check rather than a grind: learn each challenge's scoring — accuracy and speed both matter — and replay a challenge until the gold threshold is met. There is no time pressure from the story, so leave the hardest golds for the post-story cleanup when you can practice without interruption.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit both shooting ranges and attempt every challenge.
Replay each challenge until you beat its gold-medal score; 42 golds pops the trophy.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 race locations. Each location needs at least one win, so the job is breadth, not speed: visit every drone-race spot on the map and win once at each. Learn the course on a practice run, then race to win — the trophy pops when the last location is won.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find each of the 14 Top Fun drone race locations.
Win at least one race at every location.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Leonida's race scene covers street races, off-road and the other race types, so work through the race list and tick off a new event each time. Wins in races you already won do not add to the count.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Open the race list and pick an event you have not won yet.
Win it, then move to the next unwon event until 20 different wins are banked.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head contests, so bring the right approach for the spot: match the bait and technique to the fish the challenge asks for, and keep your line steady rather than rushing the catch. Challenge Cal when the fishing activity is available and out-fish him to pop the trophy.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Go fishing and find Cal's fishing challenge.
Beat Cal's catch in the challenge to pop the trophy.

trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. There are four in-game arcade games to choose from, so pick whichever you like best and play it through to the end — a single completion pops the trophy. No high score is needed, just a finished game.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade cabinet with one of the four in-game games.
Play the game through to completion.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand by playing his final mission. Andy's strand is one of the side-story questlines that stays open after the main story, so there is no rush — work through his missions in order and the trophy pops when his last one ends. Note that Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because it has its own trophy.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Find Andy's missions and play through his strand in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand by playing his final mission. Kenton's strand stays open after the main story, so finish it during the post-story cleanup. Like the other character strands, it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — it has its own trophy instead.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Find Kenton's missions and play through his strand in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand by playing his final mission. Billy's strand stays open after the main story, so finish it during the post-story cleanup. It does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because it has its own trophy.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Find Billy's missions and play through his strand in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some optional questlines count: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands do not, because they have their own trophies. Watch the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish so you know which ones counted, and keep taking stranger missions (marked as optional missions on the map) until the counter hits 8. One strand in Chapter 3 is time-sensitive — the Race Against Yago in Yago's street racing strand shows an hourglass icon — so save first, then race it the moment it appears.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Take stranger missions (optional missions on the map) and finish each strand.
Check the trophy counter after each strand — Andy, Billy and Tyrone do not count.
Do the time-sensitive Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 the moment it appears.
The trophy pops at 8 counted strands.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand by playing his final mission. Randy's strand stays open after the main story, so finish it during the post-story cleanup. It does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because it has its own trophy.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Find Randy's missions and play through his strand in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand by playing his final mission. Tyrone's strand stays open after the main story, so finish it during the post-story cleanup. It does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because it has its own trophy.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Find Tyrone's missions and play through his strand in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots in 10 locations across Leonida, with Jason and Lucia. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close. Each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. THIS IS THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, heads to the balcony of Jason's house, and you must follow her and choose Accept. That balcony meditation is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and it is not confirmed whether the trophy strictly needs it, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 manual save until the trophy pops. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of the 18 spots, so the missable one cannot cost you A Long Road. The last spots need Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: Chapter 1, morning after Down to Earth: talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony, choose Accept and meditate. Do this before Chapter 1 ends.
After Chapter 2, visit the remaining meditation spots — purple icons when close — with your partner along.
Meditate at all 18 spots; the trophy pops at the last one.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Complete Bret Vogel's hunting questline: hunt a unique animal for him. The questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which is what the hunt rewards. Work through Bret's targets in order until the unique animal is taken.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Play as Jason and take Bret Vogel's hunting quests.
Work through the target decks to the unique animal.
Take it with a clean head or heart shot to keep the carcass pristine.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida and also turn up as rewards, so collect them as you explore and check your set progress in the collection menu to see which sets are close to complete. Finish any 3 full sets and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Pick up collectible cards while exploring Leonida.
Check the collection menu to see which sets are nearest complete.
Complete any 3 full sets.

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 different locations. WAiNK is the in-game photo-sharing app: open it at a spot the game recognises as a location and post from there. The fastest route is to WAiNK everywhere you already go — mission spots, landmarks, shops and viewpoints — instead of making a separate trip for it. Scanning a vehicle with WAiNK also counts as discovering it for Whip It Good, so the two trophies feed each other.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open the WAiNK app at a recognised location and post from there.
WAiNK at 100 different locations; the trophy pops at the 100th.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the list under Progress > Challenges. Challenges cover combat, driving, exploration and the rest of Leonida's systems, and many complete on their own while you play. The 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80, so keep pushing past 50 — check the list after each session and pick off the ones nearest done.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Open Progress > Challenges and note which are nearest complete.
Play toward them deliberately; the trophy pops at 50 completed.
Keep going to 70 of 80 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape the heat. The easiest setup is a bank vault robbery: vault jobs give you a 4-star wanted level straight away, and you cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner anyway. Break line of sight, leave the flashing search area and then the red heat zone, and the trophy pops once you are clear — not the moment the stars start flashing. It pairs naturally with Maximum Withdrawal, so do them together.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Call your partner in, then start a bank vault robbery to reach 4 stars.
Escape: leave the search area, then leave the red heat zone entirely.
The trophy pops once you have fully escaped the heat.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner in, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. The chain breaks if your wanted level drops away entirely — but if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain is still alive, so keep moving to the next shop instead of stopping. Pick three shops close together, plan the route first, and give the trophy a moment after the third shop: it can take about 30 seconds to pop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Call your partner in and pick three shops close together.
Rob the first shop, then the second and third without letting the wanted level fully clear.
Wait a few seconds after the third shop for the trophy to pop.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive instead of hunting vehicles one by one. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning everything new you pass — the trophy pops at 100 and the checklist work continues from there.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app as you drive — scanning counts as discovering.
Discover 100 vehicles; keep going to 200 of 277 for 100%.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim — press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle so you can drop several before the slow-motion ends. Adrenaline extends Focus, so use it if the group is spread out.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a group of enemies, such as guards at an illegal operation.
Aim and press L3 + R3 to trigger Combat Focus.
Take down 5 enemies before the Focus ends.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge. Planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count — the ones at gates E3 and E4 work. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Save first, then go to VCIA and board a large plane docked at a bridge (gates E3 or E4).
Get to the cockpit, back out to the runway and take off.
Fly about 1 km from the airport; the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Get into a military tank — a Rhino. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until the trophy pops. Expect a heavy police response, so go in with a plan to get there and get inside quickly.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Save first, then travel to Mile Zero Air Station in the far southwest.
Find a Rhino tank on the south side of the base and get in.
Drive and fire until the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies: go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If anyone spots you, reload the save rather than pushing on.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to get the Snap Gun.
Use the Snap Gun on a jewelry store's locked back door — do not kick it in.
Find the safe-code note in the back room, open the safe, and leave unseen.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. Vault jobs give you a 4-star wanted level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults, so keep going past 5.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Finish the optional mission That's Where The Money Is near the end of Chapter 4.
Bring your partner, tail a security van to a bank, and enter the vault while the guard has it open.
Escape with the bags; repeat at 5 vaults (8 for 100%).

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida — watch for one, stop it, take the cash and get clear of the police. Like the other robbery trophies, it only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area, so keep driving until you are fully clear.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck on its route and stop it.
Take the cash from the truck.
Escape until you have fully left the red heat zone.

trophies.guide: Explore every region of Leonida — the whole state, from Vice City and the beaches to the swamps, farmland and the islands. The game tracks which areas you have visited, so the practical way is to drive the map region by region and let the tracker fill in. Anything you missed shows up as a gap, so a slow sweep of the coast and the back roads at the end is worth doing before you call this one done.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Drive through every region of Leonida, including the islands and back roads.
Check the map for unvisited areas and sweep them last.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Illegal operations are the gang-run fronts scattered across Leonida — robbing one marks that gang off the list. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations robbed, so this trophy pops along the way to that bigger goal. Work gang by gang and keep a note of which gangs you have already hit.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Find an illegal operation and rob it; that gang is marked off.
Repeat for a different gang each time until all 9 are done.
Keep going to all 39 operations for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The description points to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach: order a cocktail there and take in the view. The exact unlock method was not yet pinned down by the guides at launch, so treat this as a place-based trophy — head to the Ocean Beach bars, order a drink with the ocean in front of you, and it should pop. If it does not, try the other beachfront spots along the strip.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach.
Order a cocktail with the ocean view in front of you.
Method not yet confirmed by guides at launch — try each beachfront spot if the first does not pop it.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — the description is a nod to the classic GTA showroom escape. The exact unlock method was not yet pinned down by the guides at launch, so the reading of the description is: take a car inside a vehicle showroom and drive it straight out through the glass front. Pick a showroom with a big glass front, get in a car, and smash out through it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Go to a vehicle showroom with a glass front.
Get in a car inside the showroom and drive out through the glass.
Method not yet confirmed by guides at launch — the description is the clue.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The Kolt & Associates bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable — you can return and finish the job.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Go to Kingpin Bowling (Kolt & Associates) in Chapter 2 or later, with Sticky Bombs.
Take the luxury watch from the office and the shotgun from the table.
Blow the office safe open with a Sticky Bomb and take its contents, then escape.

trophies.guide: It should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you. Work both characters up to max Strength — the trophy is about the partnership, so training together is the point — and it pops when the second of the two maxes out.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Buy a gym membership.
Train with your partner at the gym so both gain Strength.
Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia.

trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind — just keep playing the criminal life: rob, fight, and make the choices the profile tracks. Check the counter in the Progress menu now and then; it pops at 500.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Rob, fight and make criminal choices — each one feeds the Criminal Profile counter.
Check the counter in the Progress menu; the trophy pops at 500 actions.

trophies.guide: The description — second time's the charm — points to succeeding at something on a second attempt, after failing it once. The exact unlock method was not yet pinned down by the guides at launch, so the honest advice is: when an activity fails, retry it right away instead of moving on, and the trophy should pop on the successful second try. Failing a mission or challenge and then clearing it on the retry is the most likely trigger.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Fail an activity, mission or challenge once.
Retry it right away and clear it on the second attempt.
Method not yet confirmed by guides at launch — the description is the clue.

trophies.guide: The description — what the hell just happened? — points to witnessing something strange or unexpected in the world. The exact unlock method was not yet pinned down by the guides at launch, so the honest advice is: explore the odd corners of Leonida and react to the strange events the world throws at you — UFO-style encounters, bizarre random events and the game's hidden oddities are the usual suspects for a trophy worded like this. Keep an eye on the guides as they update; this one will be pinned down as more players reach it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Explore Leonida's odd corners and strange random events.
Trigger the unexpected event the trophy is tied to.
Method not yet confirmed by guides at launch — check updated guides as players pin it down.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by: hit a target with a melee weapon while driving past. Get a vehicle up to speed, line up a target on foot, and swing the melee weapon as you pass. The name is a bowling joke — you are the ball — so a clean drive-by hit is what the trophy wants.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Get in a vehicle with a melee weapon equipped.
Drive past a target on foot and swing the melee weapon as you pass.
The trophy pops when the drive-by hit lands.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs — sell them to your contacts to launder them, and the total is cumulative across every sale. Bank vault robberies are the biggest source, so this trophy climbs while you work on Maximum Withdrawal.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Rob banks and payday loan jobs to collect marked bills.
Sell the bills to your contacts to launder them.
The trophy pops at $250,000 laundered in total.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop — clothes, weapons, food, car mods and the rest — so it climbs on its own as you kit out both characters. If you are short at the end, buy and sell high-value items or stock up on ammo and mods until the counter hits $100,000.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend money at any shops — clothes, weapons, food, car mods all count.
The total is cumulative; the trophy pops at $100,000 spent.

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count — only the ones you buy. Buy them early: garages give you somewhere to store the cars you need for On the Spot, so this trophy unlocks that one too.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver to unlock the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy all 8 garage properties (about $160,000 in total).
Story-given garages do not count — only bought ones.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars. Ten registrations pops the trophy.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses to open the Scooter Bros app.
Take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register (or use Pay 'n' Spray from Chapter 3).
Register 10 vehicles — each needs a free garage space, so buy garages first.
